title: fix(types): an undeclared hook abort answers HOOK_ABORTED on package publish and the runtime /actions doors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DNWHtgDxNLpTCKKRCiYAQZ8)_
Fixes #27672

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：钩子用自由文本中止写入且没声明错误码时，包发布与 runtime `/actions` 两类门现在也答 `HOOK_ABORTED`，与 `/api/v1/data` 一致，不再答 `VALIDATION_ERROR`。
- 为什么改：#27597 只让 `/data` 答 `HOOK_ABORTED`，其它从 `resolveThrownHttpError` 取码的门仍按 400 推导，客户端按码分支时得先知道是哪个门。
- 风险与回滚：只换这一种中止的码（状态、文案不变）；声明了码的照旧，崩溃仍是 500。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`（`undeclaredHookAbort` 一段）、`packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`（搬出 `sandboxBusinessMessage`）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions-undeclared-hook-abort-code.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/actions-undeclared-hook-abort-code.test.ts`，预期 7 个全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `resolveThrownHttpError` (`@objectstack/types`) now answers `UNDECLARED_HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE` (`HOOK_ABORTED`) for a sandboxed body's refusal that declared no code, at a 4xx status. It is the one constant `/api/v1/data` has read since #27597, now declared beside the resolver; `sandboxRefusalCodeFields` reads the same constant.
- So the doors that take their code from the resolver answer the same code as `/data`: `POST /api/v1/packages/publish` (`@objectstack/rest`, `sendThrownError`) and the runtime `/actions` doors (`errorFromThrown`). No route source changes; both already call the resolver.
- `sandboxBusinessMessage` (with its private `isScriptFaultMessage`) moved verbatim to `packages/types/src/sandbox-business-message.ts`: `data-error-classification.ts` imports `thrown-http-error.ts`, so the resolver could not read it from there without a cycle. `data-error-classification.ts` re-exports it, so `@objectstack/types` exports the same names as before. The platform-checklist anchor for it follows the move.
- Unchanged: a declared code is kept (registered → its own `code`; unregistered → `declaredCode` beside the derived `code`); `declaredCode` stays absent for an undeclared abort; a non-sandbox producer, a crash, and a sandboxed refusal resolved at a 5xx answer as before.

## Tests

- New: `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error-undeclared-hook-abort.test.ts` (resolver, §1 the card, §2 controls), `packages/rest/src/package-door-undeclared-hook-abort-code.test.ts` (publish door), `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions-undeclared-hook-abort-code.test.ts` (`/actions`: an action body's throw, a hook abort relayed through an action body, a declared 4xx status; controls).
- Flipped on purpose from `VALIDATION_ERROR` to `HOOK_ABORTED`, each with a `[#27672] FLIPPED` note: the publish row of `rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`; the four rows of `actions-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`; `nested-hook-refusal-is-a-rejection.test.ts` ("matches /data", which it does again); the thrown-Error control in `sandbox-plain-object-throw-client-sentence.test.ts`; `throw ''` and `throw Object.create(null)` in `sandbox-unreadable-rejection-door.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise measured: the dispatch placed `resolveThrownHttpError` in `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`; it is defined in `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts` (rest imports it). The fix is there, per the ruling ("`resolveThrownHttpError` answers `HOOK_ABORTED`"); the seat amended the claim's file surface. `logUnexpectedRouteError` (#27508) is untouched.
- The wrapper fallback in `classifyDataError` (an abort whose `SandboxError` instance was lost, no `innerMessage`) keeps answering the constant through `sandboxRefusalCodeFields`, because the resolver has no marker to read there.

- Ablated: types new pin 2 failed / 6 passed; rest (new publish pin + publish ledger row + /data pins) 3 failed / 603 passed, the `/data` pins staying green; runtime (5 touched files) 11 failed / 21 passed. Every control stayed green.
- Restored + rebuilt: types 8/8, rest 606/606, runtime 32/32.
</details>
